name: VolPack Normal Vector Encoding/Decoding
definition: A function to encode a normalized 3D vector into a 16-bit integer format expected by VolPack shaders.
summary: VolPack Normal Vector Encoding/Decoding compresses a normalized 3D surface normal into a 16-bit integer to reduce memory bandwidth, differing from general normalization by using a specific lossy packing scheme for the VolPack shading library.
